title: Mario Party 9
subtitle: Everyone shares the same ride
summary: Mario Party 9 is NDcube's Wii party game, first released in Europe on 2 March 2012.
body: Mario Party 9 is NDcube's Wii party game, first released in Europe on 2 March 2012. Its largest change places all four characters in one vehicle moving along the board together. Players take turns driving, gathering Mini Stars and trying to avoid the losses attached to Mini Ztars. The shared position makes the contest unusually close: everyone sees the same approaching stretch, but the person currently holding the dice controls which opportunity or danger the group reaches next.

The active driver rolls to move the vehicle, making a useful destination depend on whose turn arrives at that point in the route. Mini Stars are collected along the way instead of being purchased through the older coin-and-Star structure. Minigames appear through spaces and events rather than automatically after every full round. This changes the pace between the board and its short contests. A helpful roll for the vehicle may still leave a different player best placed to benefit from what lies immediately ahead.

Boss minigames appear midway through a board and again at its conclusion. The group fights a common enemy while still competing over the rewards, briefly joining the players around the same target. Eighty-one minigames support the different activities, and Party Points purchase additional content. Toshiki Aida and Ryosuke Asami composed the score. Mario Party 9 begins a distinct phase of the series by replacing separate journeys with a common ride, making control of the next turn more important than a player's independent position on the map.
